summary: 60-second raw screen-recording segment (4 of 8) of Maude Studio's photo-editor workflow. The canvas is parked the entire time on an unedited football-player source photo (Jan Miklica) -- it never visually changes -- while the AI assistant sidepanel autonomously narrates a background-removal pipeline: reading codebase conventions, invoking the ML-based /design:photo background removal, confirming a clean cutout ('assets/bcb3253b.png'), then switching into an Edit pass to build a new MVP Instagram-post artboard from the score-mvp/mvp-square template using Jan Miklica's stats. No user click, drag, or slider interaction is visible anywhere in this clip, and there is no on-screen before/after reveal of either the background removal or the template application -- both are only described in scrolling chat text. Text is sharp and legible throughout. Overall this segment is mostly the 'empty waiting' the brief explicitly wants to avoid; its only value is the two narrated confirmation lines (background-removal success, template-build kickoff), which could work as short text-overlay/voiceover beats but are not the crisp action shots (click, slider drag, visual before/after) the brief is hunting for -- those likely land in adjacent segments once the canvas actually updates.
